question: Who won India’s first medal at the Tokyo Olympics 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mirabai Chanu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mirabai Chanu won the silver medal in the Women's 49 kg weightlifting category at the Tokyo Olympics 2021.
 
• This was India's first medal at the Tokyo Olympics 2021, marking a historic achievement for the nation.
 
• Mirabai Chanu lifted a total of 202 kg (87 kg in snatch and 115 kg in clean & jerk) to secure the second position.
 
• Her victory ended India's 21-year wait for a weightlifting medal at the Olympics, the last being Karnam Malleswari's bronze in Sydney 2000.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Weightlifting Categories**

 
 
• Weightlifting is divided into different weight categories, and athletes compete in their respective categories.
 
• The main categories for women include 49 kg, 55 kg, 59 kg, 64 kg, 71 kg, 76 kg, 81 kg, and +87 kg.
 
• Athletes are required to lift weights in two types of lifts: the snatch and the clean & jerk.
 
• The combined total of the best successful lifts in both snatch and clean & jerk determines the winner.
 
 
 
• **Tokyo Olympics 2021**
 
 
• The Tokyo Olympics 2021, officially known as the Games of the XXXII Olympiad, was held from July 23 to August 8, 2021.
 
• Originally scheduled for 2020, the event was postponed due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• The event featured 339 events in 33 sports across 42 venues.
 
• Despite the challenges, Tokyo 2021 was one of the most memorable Olympic Games, with strict health protocols and no spectators in most events.
 
 
 
• **India's Performance**
 
 
• India sent a strong contingent to the Tokyo Olympics 2021, comprising 127 athletes.
 
• India achieved a record haul of 7 medals, including 1 gold, 2 silver, and 4 bronze.
 
• Notable medalists included Neeraj Chopra (gold in javelin throw), Ravi Kumar Dahiya (silver in wrestling), and PV Sindhu (bronze in badminton).
 
• This was India's best performance in terms of total medals won at a single Olympic Games.
